payload.author: recovery-worker
evidence: final-check.json: init's emitted references bind _memset -> 0x006465F0 and init's only remaining unresolved target is ?MapArea@@3IA (binding null, out of scope); find and sensors likewise bind _memset -> 0x006465F0
continents' emitted references contain no _memset at all - the intrinsic restoration ahead of its body kept the ZeroMemory over sea_coasts as inline stores, matching the image's calls list

the change was decked before committing (path-memset.json, 3 candidates x 2 flag sets): scoped-pragmas preserved continents' codegen exactly (1408 instructions under /O2, 1376 under /Oy-) where a TU-wide #pragma function shifted it to 1376/1360 by adding a call the image does not make
payload.hypothesis: The memset_call forwarder was replaced by scoped #pragma function(memset)/#pragma intrinsic(memset) so the three real image memset calls reference _memset directly: init (0x0059A220), find (0x0059A530) and sensors (0x0059CCA0) now emit _memset -> 0x006465F0 against the pinned CRT component binding, while continents (0x0059C790) keeps its inline constant-8 stores (intrinsic restored ahead of that body only). The old forwarder's synthetic symbol left every strict reference through it permanently unresolved; init's unresolved set dropped from two symbols to one.
